Traffic Advisories Issued for Janmashtami Celebrations Across India

Multiple Indian cities, including Delhi, Noida, and Telangana, have announced traffic restrictions and diversions in anticipation of Janmashtami celebrations. These measures are primarily focused around ISKCON temples and other major religious sites to manage the expected influx of devotees. Authorities have advised the public to plan alternate routes and adhere to the advisories. In Noida, specific roads near the ISKCON Temple and Sanatan Dharam Temple were affected, with provisions made for emergency vehicles. Delhi Police also issued advisories, suggesting alternative routes and indicating that diversions might be implemented based on the evolving situation.
